name: Alfa Romeo 8C 2900B Mille Miglia Biondetti
description:
The legendary Alfa Romeo 8C 2900B in its most powerful racing specification, as campaigned by the great Clemente Biondetti. This highly-tuned version features an upgraded supercharged 2.9-liter straight-8 engine producing 295 horsepower at 6000 RPM, significantly more than the standard 220 hp version.

Biondetti achieved remarkable success with this car, including victories at the 1938 Mille Miglia and multiple other prestigious races. The increased boost pressure and engine tuning gave this variant exceptional performance for its era, with improved acceleration and top speed approaching 200 km/h.

The lightweight construction (960 kg) combined with the massive power output results in a power-to-weight ratio of just 4.2 kg/hp, making this one of the most formidable racing machines of the late 1930s.
